This unit's part: eth_getCode on 2026-11-27 finds EntryPoint v0.6 (23,689 bytes), v0.7 (16,035 bytes) and v0.8 (21,738 bytes) at their canonical addresses on Arbitrum One, Robinhood Chain and Elysium, so the handleOps path of F-162 exists on all three. For Nitro and Elysium the trigger has not happened: Nitro master still pins holiman/uint256 v1.3.2, the module proxy latest is v1.3.2, and uint256 master is unchanged since de2a038. The three endpoints give 0 mismatches on the battery and targeted sets on v1.3.2.
